text: Closed: added 11 round-trip tests in jmap-tasks-types/tests/types_test.rs under module `jscalendar_roundtrip`. 10 tests do typed round-trip through jmap-jscalendar-types sub-types (Relation, Location, VirtualLocation, Link, RecurrenceRule x2, Participant, Alert/OffsetTrigger for Task.alerts, Alert/OffsetTrigger for TaskList.defaultAlertsWithTime, Alert/AbsoluteTrigger for TaskList.defaultAlertsWithoutTime). 1 test (Task.time_zones) does Value-only round-trip because jmap-jscalendar-types does not yet define a TimeZone typed sub-type — filed JMAP-x014 as the follow-up to add it.
